headline: Nigeria Delivers Electric Buses to Kano Operators Targeting 40% Fare Cut
summary: Nigeria's federal government, through its Presidential Initiative on Compressed Natural Gas and Electric Vehicles, deployed five electric buses to transport firms in Kano State with a target to reduce commuter fares by 40%.
why: Transitioning urban mass transit to electric and CNG vehicles is central to Nigeria's strategy to mitigate the inflationary impact of removed fuel subsidies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: State-sponsored bus deployment targets localized transport cost reductions in northern Nigeria.
